title: RunMeta
description: What produced this run. Without it two reports for the same connector cannot be compared and neither can be reproduced. Stamped into knowledge.json at Stage 1 and into the checkpoint's meta line.

models.description: Resolved model identifiers per stage class. under_test is the MCP agent being measured and must be whatever production runs.

mcp_server.description: Server name/version from getStarted() or the session config

metadata_snapshot_at.description: When getTables() was called — the schema this run tested

mode.description: capability: the 3.0 flow — capability list from the source API (Stage 1.5), frozen use case catalog (Stage 5.5), full journeys and the results store. coverage (default): the 2.x flow.

connector_build.description: The connector's build or version as getStarted() reports it. Part of the results fingerprint: runs against different builds are never compared in an eval.

workspace.description: The tenant the connection is bound to (Stage 1.0a). Part of the results fingerprint.

capability_spec.description: Where the capability list came from (Stage 1.5a): the vendor OpenAPI file the skill fetched, or the vendor API reference pages it was assembled from.

execution_mode.description: isolated_subagent: each test's SQL was generated by a fresh agent that saw only the prompt. in_thread: the orchestrator answered its own prompts — a weaker measurement.
